title: A twin run started from a project: the system and Claude on the project's table, as a job, the comparison on the project's page
request: Phase 3: run Claude beside the current system on any part of DCLab, the project's stages included, and see both at once.
spec: The job kind twin, the routes to start a project's twin run and list its runs, the project page's Claude beside pane; lanes kept as files also on a PostgreSQL workspace.
plan: Start a twin run of the project as a job so it can be stopped and counted like any other.
Show each run's lanes, differences, judged steps, the comparison and the expert's story on the project's page.

decisions.decision: The lanes keep files even when the workspace is on PostgreSQL, and the run is no longer refused there.
decisions.why: Only the lane's audit reached the database; with a file audit of its own each lane is a folder, and the owner's development server is on PostgreSQL.

decisions.decision: Claude's stage choices are not written into the project's ledger.
decisions.why: The ledger is written where a decision is made; the project made none, and the teacher sets of 25.7 hold Claude's answers beside the rule's.

change: dclab_rnd/jobs/handlers.py (twin), agentic/services.py (its busy message), agentic/routers/projects.py (two routes), web/src/views/project.html (the pane), twin/__init__.py and lane.py (files under PostgreSQL), tests/test_twin_runs.py.

findings.defect: A twin run was refused on a workspace kept in PostgreSQL.
findings.scenario: The owner's development server uses PostgreSQL: a project's twin run would have failed at once.
findings.cause: The run refused any database because a lane's audit went to it.
findings.fix: A lane's audit is a file of its own; the refusal is gone and the source project is read from the workspace's own stores.

outcome: A project's twin run works as a job on a scripted transport.
lessons: Before refusing a storage mode, find the one writer that needs it and give that writer a file.
risks: A live run spends within the workspace's session budget each time it is started.
